description: Defines the QuicHeadersStream class for handling HTTP/2 headers over QUIC protocol, including methods for managing header streams, acknowledgments, retransmissions, and internal data structures.

classes.name: quic::QuicHeadersStream
classes.description: Handles sending and receiving HTTP/2 headers over a QUIC stream, manages header acknowledgment, retransmission, and stream reset.

classes.name: quic::QuicHeadersStream::CompressedHeaderInfo
classes.description: Stores metadata about compressed headers, including stream offset, length, unacked bytes, and acknowledgment listener.

methods.name: QuicHeadersStream
methods.description: Constructor initializing the headers stream with a session.

methods.name: MaybeReleaseSequencerBuffer
methods.description: Releases the buffer if conditions allow.

methods.name: IsConnected
methods.description: Checks if the session is still connected.

methods.name: OnDataBuffered
methods.description: Stores mapping from data offset and length to acknowledgment listener.
